title: Membership
content:
# Membership

Club membership is managed by [RiderHQ](https://www.riderhq.com/groups/chippenham-wheelers/join), with payments taken online. Any membership queries can be sent to [secretary@chippenhamwheelers.org](mailto:secretary@chippenhamwheelers.org).

## Chippenham Sports and Social Club

Since 2019, Chippenham Wheelers has been affiliated with the [Chippenham Sports and Social Club](http://www.chippenhamsportsclub.co.uk/) as a sports section. Club membership fees include CSSC membership.

Members can use CSSC facilities, including:

- Bar areas and rooms with member discounts.
- Toilets and showers before and after club rides.
- Food and drink at weekends.
- Free parking.
- The bowling club pavilion for club events.
- The main hall and skittles alley for larger events.
- Discounted hire of club facilities.

## Membership Year and Prices

The membership year runs to 1 April. Current prices and renewal terms are maintained by RiderHQ.

- January and February: £10, valid until 1 April that year.
- March to June: £40, valid until 1 April the following year.
- July to September: £30, valid until 1 April the following year.
- October to December: £20, valid until 1 April the following year.

These prices apply to Senior membership; other categories are priced proportionally.

## Membership Categories

### Senior — £40

- Standard membership for people aged 18 and over.
- Eligible for all club rides and events.
- Receive club communications.

### Couple — £60

- Both members are eligible for club rides and events.
- Both receive club communications.
- Best value for two Senior members.

### Additional Child — £5

- Used with Couple membership.
- For a child under 18 at the time of joining.
- Eligible for age-appropriate club rides and events.

### Under 18 — £15

- For a member under 18 at the time of joining.
- Eligible for age-appropriate club rides and events.
- Receive club communications.

## Join or Renew

Membership administration, account management and payment processing remain with RiderHQ.

[Apply for membership](https://www.riderhq.com/groups/chippenham-wheelers/join)
